query: dfki dkt at semeval 2017 task 8 rumour detection and classification using cascading heuristics
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
LEFT JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE
  to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title,'') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract,'')) @@ plainto_tsquery('english', 'semeval & 2017 & rumour & detection & classification')
  OR (p.title ILIKE '%semeval%' AND p.title ILIKE '%2017%' AND p.title ILIKE '%rumour%' AND p.title ILIKE '%detection%' AND p.title ILIKE '%classification%')
  OR (p.abstract ILIKE '%semeval%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%2017%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%rumour%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%detection%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%classification%')
  OR a.name ILIKE '%dfki%'
ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title,'') || ' ' || coalesce(p.abstract,'')),
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'dfki dkt semeval 2017 task 8 rumour detection classification cascading heuristics')
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: translating named entities using monolingual and bilingual resources
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  p.year
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    (p.title ILIKE '%named entit%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%named entit%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%translat%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%translat%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%entity translation%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%entity translation%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%name translation%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%name translation%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%proper name%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%proper name%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%translat%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%translat%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%monolingual%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%monolingual%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%bilingual%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%bilingual%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%lexicon%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%lexicon%' OR
         p.title ILIKE '%dictionary%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%dictionary%' OR
         p.title ILIKE '%resource%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%resource%')
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%named entit%' AND p.title ILIKE '%translat%') THEN 1
    WHEN (p.abstract ILIKE '%named entit%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%translat%') THEN 2
    WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%entity translation%' OR p.title ILIKE '%name translation%') THEN 3
    WHEN (p.abstract ILIKE '%entity translation%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%name translation%') THEN 4
    WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%monolingual%' AND p.title ILIKE '%bilingual%') THEN 5
    WHEN (p.abstract ILIKE '%monolingual%' AND p.abstract ILIKE '%bilingual%') THEN 6
    ELSE 100
  END,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,

      'bilingual projection feature tagging "feature tag" "feature-tag" monolingual dictionary lexicon lexicography cross-lingual "cross lingual"')
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

query: class prior estimation for learning from positive and unlabeled data
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    p.title ILIKE '%class prior estimation%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%class prior estimation%'
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%class prior%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%class prior%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%positive and unlabeled%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%positive and unlabeled%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%class prior%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%class prior%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%PU learning%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%PU learning%')
  )
  OR (
    (p.title ILIKE '%class prior%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%class prior%')
    AND (p.title ILIKE '%positive-unlabeled%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%positive-unlabeled%')
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%class prior estimation for learning from positive and unlabeled data%' THEN 5
    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%class prior estimation%' THEN 4
    WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%class prior estimation for learning from positive and unlabeled data%' THEN 4
    WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%class prior estimation%' THEN 3
    WHEN (p.title ILIKE '%class prior%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%class prior%')
         AND (p.title ILIKE '%positive and unlabeled%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%positive and unlabeled%') THEN 2
    ELSE 1
  END DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST,
  p.year DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

  p.corpus_id,

  p.year,
  p.citation_count

   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%imitation learning%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +

   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%behavior cloning%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%behavior cloning%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +

   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%video%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +

ORDER BY

   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%function approximator%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +

query: graph kernels between point clouds
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.citation_count,
  p.year
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    p.title ILIKE '%graph kernel%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%graph-based kernel%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%graph kernels%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%kernel on graphs%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%graph neural tangent kernel%'
  )
  OR (
    p.abstract IS NOT NULL AND (
      (p.abstract ILIKE '%graph kernel%' OR
       p.abstract ILIKE '%graph-based kernel%' OR
       p.abstract ILIKE '%graph kernels%' OR
       p.abstract ILIKE '%kernel on graphs%' OR
       p.abstract ILIKE '%graph neural tangent kernel%')
      AND
      (p.abstract ILIKE '%point cloud%' OR
       p.abstract ILIKE '%point clouds%' OR
       p.abstract ILIKE '%3d point%' OR
       p.abstract ILIKE '%3-d point%' OR
       p.abstract ILIKE '%3d shape%' OR
       p.abstract ILIKE '%3-d shape%')
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%graph kernel%' AND (p.title ILIKE '%point cloud%' OR p.title ILIKE '%point clouds%') THEN 1
    WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%graph kernel%' AND (p.abstract ILIKE '%point cloud%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%point clouds%') THEN 2
    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%graph kernel%' THEN 3
    WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%graph kernel%' THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END,
  p.citation_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100

query: identifying user corrections automatically in spoken dialogue systems
sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.venue,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
WHERE
  (
    (p.title ILIKE '%user correction%' OR p.title ILIKE '%user corrections%' OR p.title ILIKE '%self-correction%' OR p.title ILIKE '%self correction%' OR p.title ILIKE '%error correction%')
    OR
    (p.abstract ILIKE '%user correction%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%user corrections%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%self-correction%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%self correction%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%error correction%')
  )
  AND
  (
    (p.title ILIKE '%spoken dialogue%' OR p.title ILIKE '%spoken dialog%' OR p.title ILIKE '%spoken conversation%' OR p.title ILIKE '%speech dialog%' OR p.title ILIKE '%speech dialogue%')
    OR
    (p.abstract ILIKE '%spoken dialogue%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%spoken dialog%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%spoken conversation%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%speech dialog%' OR p.abstract ILIKE '%speech dialogue%')
  )
ORDER BY
  ts_rank_cd(
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.title, '')), 'A') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(p.abstract, '')), 'B'),
    plainto_tsquery('english', 'user correction | self-correction | error correction & spoken dialogue | spoken dialog | speech dialog')
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC,
  p.year DESC
LIMIT 100

  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
